reuse.why: Routes all five inline midpoint copies through the existing getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules rather than re-deriving the 7.5% tolerance.

duplication.why: The repeated midpoint/missing/number dispatch is removed everywhere; only schedule-template keeps a residual op dispatch around the helper call.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules next to the other schedule helpers, and the API field is computed in the api-models scheduleModel mapper.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule, the call sites and the API field, plus tests and release notes; the forecast raw type gains _amountOp only to feed the helper.

maintainability.why: The op parameter is optional and placed after an unused inverse flag, so every server caller passes `false` positionally and the desktop-client callers that omit op silently keep the exact value for approximate amounts, leaving two behaviours under one name.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/budget/schedule-template.ts createScheduleList keeps its own `op === 'isbetween' || op === 'isapprox' ? getScheduledAmount(...) : value` dispatch instead of passing the op straight to the helper; desktop-client callers (Balance, SchedulesTable, mobile list, useScheduleEdit) call it without op.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic is reshaped; the copies are replaced by calls to the shared helper.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains an optional `op` parameter and an `isapprox` branch for the tolerance; schedule-template.ts decides at the call site which ops reach the helper.
